question: Who is the head of the committee constituted by the Central Government to consider the withdrawal of AFSPA from Nagaland?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vivek Joshi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Vivek Joshi, **is appointed as **Registrar General and Census Commissioner. (16 Jan 2019)**.
 
• **Vivek Joshi i**s currently posted as Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India under the** Ministry of Home Affairs, **Government of India, since January, 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Piyush Vedprakash Goyal **is a politician and cabinet minister of the Government of India having portfolios such as Minister of Textiles, Minister of** Commerce and Industry and Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.**
 
• **Rajiv Gauba** is an Indian civil servant serving as the **Cabinet Secretary of India **since 2019. Prior to his appointment as Cabinet Secretary, he was Home Secretary of India,Working as Cabinet Secretary.
 
• **Ajay Kumar Bhalla** is the** Home Secretary of India.** He assumed the office on 23 August 2019, succeeding **Rajiv gauba.**
